desc: The Bushnell A5 is the flagship of the A-Series line, designed for outdoor enthusiasts who want the brightest, most color-accurate views. Larger 42 mm objectives gather more light, while dielectric and phase-coated prisms deliver true color and contrast. The wave-pattern soft rubber armor — inspired by dunes and water — provides a sure, comfortable hold when conditions get wet. With Waterproof (IPX7 rated) protection, EXO Barrier lens coatings, and the Snap-Lock strap system, A5 blends performance, protection, and modern outdoor style — all backed by the Bushnell Lifetime Warranty.
